text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The European Commission is studying applying sanctions on Portuguese farmers for excessive cereals production.

- Fishermen who yesterday blockaded Lisbon's port to protest against a government decree that forbids them to fish for a 24- hour period on weekends meet with Agriculture Minister Fernando Gomes da Silva today.
- Spanish oil company Cepsa is fighting a price war with Esso in Portugal.
- The number of potential shareholders of state electricity company EDP - more than 740,000 - is three times initial forecasts.
- The government was defeated in parliament yesterday when the opposition rejected a bill to change the penal code.
- The government will postpone until next year the privatisations of motorway company Brisa, pulp company Portucel Industrial and oil company Petrogal, government sources said.
